overview.title: Self-Hosted Platform and Your Privacy
overview.content: ScholaFlow is a self-hostable learning platform. When you use this instance of ScholaFlow, your account, schoolwork, and personal information are stored and managed directly by the organization or administrator hosting this deployment. The software does not sell personal information or track you across external websites.

infoCollect.title: Information Stored on This Instance
infoCollect.intro: This deployment stores information you provide when using the platform:
items: Account details: Your name, email address, profile picture, and school or organization name.
Login and session records: Secure credentials (such as password or Google sign-in) and active login sessions (including general device type, browser, and IP address) to keep your account secure.
Coursework and grades: Assignment files, links, quiz submissions, turn-in timestamps, and grades assigned by instructors.
Classroom communications: Public announcements, class stream comments, and real-time class chat messages.
Private messages: One-on-one private feedback and comments exchanged directly between students and instructors.
Personal notes: Your personal notes, pinned thoughts, and private attachments created in your notepad.
Preferences: Your selected theme (light or dark mode) and notification read states.

visibility.title: Who Can See Your Content
visibility.intro: Your privacy depends on the type of content you share:
items: Personal notes: Strictly private to you. No classmates or instructors can view your personal notes or note attachments.
Coursework and grades: Only visible to you and the instructors of that class. Other students cannot see what you turned in or your grades.
Private comments: Strictly between you and your instructor on specific assignments.
Class stream and chats: Visible to all enrolled students and teachers in that specific classroom.
Class roster: Your name and profile picture are displayed to fellow members of your classes.

hostResponsibility.title: How Your Data Is Managed
hostResponsibility.content: Because this is a self-hosted platform, the administrator of this instance controls where data is stored, how backups are handled, and how user accounts are managed. Server logs and files are held within the infrastructure configured by the hosting administrator.

storageRetention.title: Data Storage and Account Deletion
items: Storage: Uploaded documents, homework attachments, and profile images are saved in the storage configured by this instance's administrator.
Closing your account: If you close your account, your profile, personal notes, and private files are deleted from the system.
Course records: Past submissions and grades may remain part of the instructor's class records in accordance with the host institution's policies.

educationalUse.title: Student and Youth Privacy
educationalUse.content: ScholaFlow can be deployed across all educational levels—from primary schools to universities. When used by younger students, accounts and permissions are managed and supervised by the deploying school, organization, or instructor in accordance with their institutional policies and parental consent guidelines.

choices.title: Your Choices and Control
choices.content: You can update your profile, change your photo, manage notification settings, edit your personal notes, or close your account at any time from your account settings.

changes.title: Changes to this Policy
changes.content: This policy may be updated periodically by the deployment administrator to reflect new features or organizational policies.

contact.title: Contact and Support
contact.content: If you have questions about your account, data, or this platform instance, contact your classroom administrator or reach out to the open-source project at <emailLink>scholaflow@gmail.com</emailLink> or <githubLink>open an issue on GitHub.</githubLink>
